Today (the 17th), some netizens uploaded clips on social media showing what appears to be CCTV footage from a back alley, where three people were chatting, and at least two of them were clearly seen wearing uniforms of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. Based on the department's uniform information, the two are suspected to be a Hawker Control Officer and a Senior Hawker Control Officer.

The footage shows two officer-level personnel chatting in a back alley. First, one person took out a cigarette and was smoking, then another Senior Hawker Control Officer walked over, took out a cigarette pack and a lighter, gently brushed his hair, put a cigarette into his mouth, and as he walked away with his back to the camera, a wisp of smoke drifted from his side.

集誌社 (The Collective) inquired with the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department whether the individuals in the footage were FEHD employees. The department confirmed in response to the inquiry that the individuals in the footage were members of the FEHD's District Hawker Control Team. The spokesperson said the incident occurred in early June this year. The reporter asked whether FEHD personnel are allowed to smoke while in uniform, whether the personnel would be in violation if the footage were authentic, and whether this would affect the department's image. The FEHD replied that according to the department's established regulations, personnel are prohibited from smoking while in uniform and in public places.

The FEHD stated that the department attaches great importance to the discipline and professional conduct of its employees, has already launched a disciplinary investigation into the incident, and will take appropriate action in accordance with established procedures and the findings of the investigation. The spokesperson also said that the department has clear requirements regarding the behaviour of personnel while in uniform, and any conduct that violates the department's disciplinary requirements will be followed up on seriously.
